statement: ∀ (c : ℝ), 0 < c → c ≤ 1 → Ico 0 c = Ioo (-c) c ∩ Ico 0 1 ∧ IsOpen (Subtype.val ⁻¹' Ico 0 c) ∧ ¬IsOpen (Ico 0 c)

# name: set-half-open-relative-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Subspace.half_open_relative
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)'], False, "have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1), Ico 0 c = Ioo (-c) c ∩ Ico 0 1 ∧ IsOpen ((Subtype.val : Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 → ℝ) ⁻¹' Ico 0 c) ∧ ¬ IsOpen (Ico (0 : ℝ) c) := by
  intro c hc hc1
  have heq : Ico 0 c = Ioo (-c) c ∩ Ico 0 1 := by
    ext x; simp only [mem_Ico, mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨⟨by linarith, h2⟩, h1, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, h2⟩, h1, _⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  refine ⟨heq, ?_, (OpenSets.intervals_open_closed 0 c hc).2.2.1⟩
  rw [heq, preimage_inter]
  have h1 : (Subtype.val : Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 → ℝ) ⁻¹' Ico 0 1 = univ := by ext x; simp [x.2]
  rw [h1, inter_univ]
  exact isOpen_Ioo.preimage continuous_subtype_val
exact @key (1/2) ((by norm_num)) ((by norm_num))"),
    (['1', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)'], True, "have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1), Ico 0 c = Ioo (-c) c ∩ Ico 0 1 ∧ IsOpen ((Subtype.val : Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 → ℝ) ⁻¹' Ico 0 c) ∧ ¬ IsOpen (Ico (0 : ℝ) c) := by

  refine ⟨heq, ?_, (OpenSets.intervals_open_closed 0 c hc).2.2.1⟩
